evidence_scope: fixed train_explore sessions 1..100 cached smoke on a shared cohort; not private, not independent validation, not the 2000-session promotion test
hypothesis: preserving the incumbent's first two pages and ordering only the post-grace unseen legal tail by the already-frozen held-outer score can rescue at least one smoke miss without harming an incumbent hit or any aggregate metric

global_incumbent.interpretation: comparable shared-cohort OOF incumbent; not a private score

unique_mechanism.O: the frozen reconstructed v1.9 C100 order after the frozen chosen/activation slot-10 action
unique_mechanism.raw: the original blind-trace C100, with each product's immutable raw ordinal 0..99
unique_mechanism.score: the frozen held-outer float32 semantic-off score aligned to raw ordinal
unique_mechanism.reset: before selecting a page, on the first response or a visible decoded intent-version change, clear only this policy's served set and set intent age to one
unique_mechanism.age_3_plus_H: unserved products from O[0:10] in O order
unique_mechanism.age_3_plus_T: unserved products belonging to O[10:100], ordered by numpy.lexsort((raw_ordinal,-float32_score)); no rounding, tolerance, normalization, blend, threshold, or refill
unique_mechanism.age_3_plus_F: served products from O[0:100] in O order
unique_mechanism.state_update: after selection, add exactly the ten actually returned products to the active-version served set and increment age only within that visible version
invariants: first two pages of every intent version equal fixed-two-page grace byte-for-byte
unseen head order is unchanged; only unseen legal-tail internal order uses score priority
seen candidates remain the final fallback
each output has ten unique members drawn from the same current raw C100
retrieval, P11, v1.9, grace page count, question order, scores, folds, and model parameters are unchanged

frozen_smoke_cohort.prefix_canonicalization: parse each of the first 1000 physical rows; normalize ordinal as (shard_number-1)*500+ordinal; json.dumps full object with sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=false,allow_nan=false; append one LF

label_attach.purpose: reproduce the already-frozen comparator and compute metrics for rows 0:100 only; targets are evaluator-side labels and never runtime features

metric_contract.population: the fixed 100 sessions only; all ten turns retained
metric_contract.eligibility: one-based turn >= sealed eligible_from; miss first-hit turn is 11
metric_contract.mrr: mean reciprocal rank at the first eligible hit, zero for miss
metric_contract.mttc: mean first-hit turn, using 11 for miss
metric_contract.official_rounding: round HR, MRR and MTTC to 6 decimals; efficiency=max(0,1-(rounded_MTTC-1)/10); TechnicalScore=0.50*rounded_HR+0.30*rounded_MRR+0.20*efficiency; round reported efficiency and TechnicalScore to 6 decimals
metric_contract.comparison_precision: all directional gates must pass both exact rational metrics and official-6dp metrics

required_aggregate_result_fields: same-attach grace and candidate HR/MRR/MTTC/TechnicalScore in exact and official-6dp form
miss-to-hit, hit-to-miss, net hits, changed sessions, changed turns, and activation
per-outer-fold baseline/candidate metrics and transitions as diagnostics; smoke promotion does not add an unpreregistered fold gate
policy P95, peak RSS, GPU peak, wall time, environment, source hashes, receipt hash omission, and implementation commit

outcome_protocol.receipt: O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL plus O_BINARY when available; write canonical pending marker and fsync before label access
outcome_protocol.post_receipt_failure: catch BaseException, overwrite the same descriptor with aggregate INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED, fsync, and forbid rerun
outcome_protocol.result: aggregate-only JSON; no session/product identifiers, target/rank vectors, or per-session membership

checkpoint_choreography.formal_gate: HEAD equals remote implementation commit; worktree clean including untracked; exact parents and path sets; fixed result absent; protocol/source/blob/environment identities exact

decision.go: only all smoke gates authorize a separately preregistered one-time cached 2000-session nested-OOF exact-repeat comparison; smoke is not deployment evidence
decision.no_go: record and close this exact combination without variants; do not open the 2000-session outcome; continue immediately to clause-isolated target-blind C200 then C400 candidate-recall probes
